original_action: TempBuf の変換を実装する
rationale: Modern GimpTempBuf and GEGL/GdkPixbuf bridges replace legacy TempBuf storage adapters. Actual production tests establish stride/format/ownership conversion without recreating obsolete leaking wrappers. All34assigned source identities and unfinished whole-hunk statuses remain; 6dispatcher,21PixelRegion,1pixel.hpp and6TempBuf duties retain explicit existing successor ownership.
